---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or capability for Perimeter
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation (e.g., "Currently, the session graph engine only handles...").

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how it fits into the Perimeter architecture (Discovery, Analytics, or Defense).

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Security & Operational Impact
Describe any latency, resilience, or compliance implications of this proposed change.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or references (e.g. OWASP API Security Top 10 mappings).
